input.idea: CLI that walks a directory tree, greps TODO/FIXME/HACK comments from source files (configurable globs), enriches each finding with git blame (author + date + SHA), and emits a report as JSON or Markdown grouped by file. This is a LINTER for outstanding comments — NOT a todo-list app, NOT a CRUD storage tool. Bun+TypeScript, npm-distributed, no runtime deps beyond Bun built-ins. Tests: fixture unit tests for the extractor AND integration tests cloning postgres/postgres and postgres-ai/database-lab.
